map_text.2001: The planets in this galaxy are connected by a mysterious bond.
map_text.2002: Many explorers are attracted to this galaxy by the glow of minerals on its planets
map_text.2003: The unique appearance of the planets here is known across the universe
map_text.2004: If you wish to land on one of the planets here you will need to mind the satellites moving in their orbits.
map_text.2005: The galaxy is silent and dead. You might get lost if you don't get out of here in a short time...
map_text.2006: The phantom of the stars and planets forms the greatest view in the universe
map_text.2007: Stardust envelops the planets here and when viewed from a distance it looks like a fairy's robe.
map_text.2008: The planets are isolated from outer space by transparent barriers someone must be trying to hide something from us.
map_text.2009: No one dares to approach the palace of Galaxy Tyrant. Maybe that's just the reason the Space Pirates set their rally point here.

text.GALAXY_TRIP_HELP01: Requirement & Duration|1. Galaxy Voyage will occur in seasons consisting of an exploration period (27 days) and a result phase (1 day).|2. The feature will be unlocked after passing Campaign Stage 16-4 and when you have at least one 10-star Girl.|Feature Introduction|1. You can explore the galaxy in Galaxy Voyage. The enemy will become stronger and the rewards will become better as you explore further on your voyage.|2. Special events will occur during your explorations. You can clear an area instantly and claim the reward for exploring the area in an enemy encounter after defeating the enemy. For other special events it will take you some time to complete the exploration.|3. Only the first System is available for exploration at the beginning of each season. You will need to meet certain requirements to unlock more Systems. View more details by tapping on "Progress" in the System maps.|4. You can only explore 1 System at a time. If you decide to swap to another System the exploration progress you made in your current System will not be saved (Exploration Points and Galaxy Stones you obtained from the System however will be saved).|5. System of Eternity will be unlocked after you meet the requirements in the 4th System in each season. You can obtain more rewards by defeating Space Pirates and Galaxy Tyrant in the System.|6. You can obtain rewards in Voyager Passport after the number of your Exploration Points reaches certain requirements. You can also exchange more rewards with Galaxy Stones in the store of this feature.|7. All ongoing Explorations will be Recalled when the result phase begins. You can still claim the rewards from the Explored areas in the result phase but the Exploration Points of these areas will not be counted.|8. Your Exploration Points and Exploration Progress will be reset at the beginning of each season please remember to claim your rewards unlocked in Voyager Passport.
text.GALAXY_TRIP_HELP02: System Map Introduction|1. Exploration Points for completing a same special event in different Systems will be the same but other rewards will be different according to the System you're in.|Special Event Details:|Normal Enemy - HP won't reset to 100%% after being challenged (obtainable Exploration Points: 2)|Elite Enemy - HP won't be reset to 100%% after being challenged (obtainable Exploration Points: 4)|Ruler – Enemies need to be defeated in 1 challenge attempt (obtainable Exploration Points: 10)|Blank Space – To explore a Blank Space requires 2 hours (obtainable Exploration Points: 1)|Mystery Planet – To explore a Mystery Planet requires 1 hour (obtainable Exploration Points: 1 and a battle buff which will only be effective in your current System)|Supply Crate - To explore a Supply Crate requires 12 hours (obtainable Exploration Points: 1 and additional rewards)|Space Pirate - Enemies need to be defeated in 1 challenge attempt (obtainable Exploration Points: 10)|Galaxy Tyrant - Enemies need to be defeated in 1 challenge attempt (obtainable Exploration Points depends on difficulty level)|2. The starting point and the end point of a System are at the top and bottom of the map. You can explore the 4 Areas beside (↑↓←→) the starting point or beside the Areas that have been Explored.|3. You can explore a System by tapping on the Exploration Areas (The areas with enemies excluded). But you can also preset an exploration plan to explore multiple Exploration Areas by tapping the "Route" button.|4. When you're exploring according to a route you have preset you can tap on the "Recall" button to cancel your current Exploration instantly and claim the rewards of the special events completed already. After that you can adjust your Exploration Route for the next Exploration.|5. You are able to reduce the HP and Attack of the Ruler of the System (System of Eternity excluded) by 1%% for every area you explore further after your Exploration Progress reaches 30%%. (You can reduce the HP and Attack of each Ruler by 40%% at most in this way)|6. You will need to consume 1 Galaxy Challenge Coupon for each challenge attempt against enemies in the Systems (Enemies in System of Eternity excluded). The number of Galaxy Challenge Coupon you have will increase by 10 each day. You can own 25 Galaxy Challenge Coupons at most at the same time.|7. When you enter the map for the first time each day new Space Pirates will appear. The number of new Space Pirates in the system will increase as you unlock more Systems. Each Space Pirate will stay in the System for 72 hours please remember to defeat them in time.|8. The highest difficulty level available at the start of each season is 5 you will be able to unlock higher difficulty levels by winning in battles against Galaxy Tyrant of the highest difficulty level available. (The highest difficulty level you can reach is 20)|9. If you defeat a Galaxy Tyrant of high level. The rewards for defeating the Galaxy Tyrants of the lower levels will also be given (If you haven't won these rewards).

text.GALAXY_TRIP_HELP03: Voyage Team Introduction|1. You can set up 3 Voyage teams in the feature to provide additional battle buffs Exploration Time Reduction and Exploration Loot Increase in Galaxy Voyage. The bonus effect each Voyage Team provides will be increased if the Total Limit Break Stage of the Girls in the team reaches 5/10/15/20/25/30. But if the total Limit Break Stage of your Girls in a team is below 5 no buff will be provided by that team.|2. If a Girl is assigned to a Voyage Team she can still be available for the battles you encounter in Galaxy Voyage.|3. You cannot adjust your Voyage Teams during an ongoing Exploration.
